# Exclusion Patternssvg image

Relevant source files

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This document explains the file and directory exclusion system used during context file packaging operations. Exclusion patterns determine which files and directories are omitted when building context files with `buildcontext` and `buildcontexthtml`.

For information about how files are processed after exclusion filtering, see [Packaging and Reconstruction](/ray0404/Contexter/3.2-packaging-and-reconstruction). For details about specific build commands and their options, see [Building Commands](/ray0404/Contexter/5.1-building-commands).

---

## Overviewsvg image

The exclusion pattern system filters out unwanted files and directories during the packaging process. This prevents build artifacts, version control directories, dependency caches, and other non-essential files from being included in context files.

The system operates on two levels:

1. **Default Patterns**: Pre-configured patterns that exclude common development artifacts
2. **Custom Patterns**: User-specified patterns provided via the `--exclude` command-line argument

Both pattern types use shell-style glob matching via Python's `fnmatch` module.

**Sources**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py20-23](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L20-L23) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L57-L57) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py18](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L18-L18)

---

## Default Exclusion Patternssvg image

The system defines a set of default exclusion patterns in the `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS` constant located in `contexter_utils.py`. These patterns are automatically applied to all packaging operations.

### Pattern Listsvg image

| Pattern | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `.git*` | Excludes Git repository data (`.git`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`) |
| `node_modules` | Excludes Node.js dependency directory |
| `__pycache__` | Excludes Python bytecode cache directories |
| `*.pyc` | Excludes compiled Python files |
| `*.pyo` | Excludes optimized Python bytecode |
| `dist` | Excludes distribution/build output directories |
| `build` | Excludes build artifact directories |
| `.venv` | Excludes Python virtual environment (dotted) |
| `venv` | Excludes Python virtual environment (non-dotted) |
| `*.lock` | Excludes package lock files (e.g., `package-lock.json`, `Pipfile.lock`) |
| `.DS_Store` | Excludes macOS filesystem metadata |
| `*.log` | Excludes log files |
| `.contexter_cache` | Excludes Contexter's own cache directory |

### Default Pattern Definitionsvg image

**Sources**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py20-23](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L20-L23)

## Pattern Matching Mechanismsvg image

Exclusion patterns use shell-style glob syntax provided by Python's `fnmatch` module. The matching follows standard Unix shell wildcard conventions.

### Glob Syntaxsvg image

| Pattern | Matches | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `*` | Any sequence of characters | `*.py` matches `script.py`, `module.py` |
| `?` | Any single character | `test?.py` matches `test1.py`, `testA.py` |
| `[seq]` | Any character in sequence | `[0-9]*` matches files starting with digits |
| `[!seq]` | Any character not in sequence | `[!.]*.py` matches Python files not starting with `.` |

### Matching Processsvg image

The system iterates through all exclusion patterns and checks each file or directory name using:

If any pattern matches, the item is excluded from processing.

### 2. Directory Tree Traversal Filteringsvg image

During `os.walk()` traversal, the system filters subdirectories **in-place** to prevent descending into excluded directories:

The in-place modification (`dirs[:] = ...`) ensures `os.walk()` does not traverse into excluded directories, improving performance by avoiding unnecessary file system operations.

**Sources**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L29-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L35-L35)

### 3. File List Filteringsvg image

Files within each directory are filtered before processing:

Only files that do not match any exclusion pattern are included in the context file.

## Pattern Matching Scopesvg image

### What Patterns Match Againstsvg image

Exclusion patterns are matched against **basenames only**, not full paths. This means:

- `node_modules` matches any directory named `node_modules` at any depth
- `*.pyc` matches any file ending in `.pyc` anywhere in the tree
- `test_*` matches files or directories starting with `test_` at any level

### Path Matching Behaviorsvg image

**Note**: Patterns do not support path separators. To exclude specific paths, you would need to process the full path, which is not currently supported by the system.

**Sources**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py29-30](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L29-L30) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py28](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L28-L28) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L35-L35) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py37](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L37-L37)

## Common Use Casessvg image

### Excluding Test Filessvg image

Excludes both `test_*.py` and `*_test.py` naming conventions.

### Excluding Specific File Typessvg image

Excludes all image and PDF files that would otherwise be marked as binary.

### Excluding Documentationsvg image

Excludes the `docs` directory and all Markdown files (note: this would exclude all `.md` files, including the output file if in the same tree).

### Excluding Configuration Filessvg image

Excludes environment files and configuration files that may contain sensitive data.

## Implementation Detailssvg image

### Pattern Storagesvg image

Both `context_builder.py` and `build_context_html.py` store the combined exclusion patterns in a local variable:

This variable is then passed to:

- Recursive processing functions (`process_path_for_md`)
- The `generate_file_tree()` utility function
- Inline filtering expressions during `os.walk()` traversal

**Sources**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L57-L57) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py18](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L18-L18)

### Performance Considerationssvg image

The exclusion system is designed for performance:

1. **In-Place Directory Filtering**: Modifying `dirs[:]` during `os.walk()` prevents unnecessary directory traversal
2. **Early Termination**: Top-level path checks prevent processing of entire excluded subtrees
3. **Sorted Output**: Results are sorted after filtering, not before, reducing sorting overhead

### Recursion and Pattern Propagationsvg image

In `context_builder.py`, the exclusion patterns are propagated through recursive calls:

The `exclude_patterns` parameter ensures consistent filtering across all recursion levels.

**Sources**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py11-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L33)

---

## Pattern Interaction with Binary Detectionsvg image

Exclusion patterns are applied **before** binary file detection. This means:

1. Files matching exclusion patterns are never checked for binary content
2. Binary detection only runs on files that pass exclusion filtering
3. Excluded binary files do not generate "SKIPPED (BINARY)" markers

This ordering improves performance by avoiding unnecessary binary checks on files that will be excluded anyway.

### Processing Ordersvg image

**Sources**: [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py30](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L30-L30) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py36-38](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L36-L38) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py37](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L37-L37) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)build\_context\_html.py39-41](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/build_context_html.py#L39-L41)

---

## Limitationssvg image

1. **Basename Matching Only**: Patterns cannot match against full paths or path components
2. **No Negation**: Cannot specify "exclude everything except X"
3. **No Regular Expressions**: Only shell-style glob patterns are supported
4. **Case Sensitivity**: Pattern matching is case-sensitive (platform-dependent via `fnmatch`)

For advanced filtering requirements, users may need to:

- Pre-filter the directory structure before running build commands
- Use multiple build commands with different exclusion sets
- Post-process the context file to remove unwanted sections
